steps.title: 1. Boss Goals & Win Condition
steps.description: Step 1: Choose which endgame bosses qualify as goals and how many are required to win

items.title: ⚡ Quick Run (1 Goal)
items.desc: Shortest session. Defeat any 1 target boss to clear the seed.

items.title: 🎯 Standard Multiworld (3 Goals)
items.desc: Balanced progression. Complete 3 boss goals across your runs.

items.title: 🏆 Long Campaign (5+ Goals)
items.desc: Extended run covering paths to most major endgame encounters.

steps.title: 2. Item Pool & Progression
steps.description: Step 2: Customize check density, permanent stat increases, and persistent upgrades

controls.label: Item Location Percentage (% of item checks randomized):
Permanent Stat Upgrades in Pool (Retained across runs):
Progressive Map Upgrades (Map -> Compass -> Blue Map in pool)
Progressive Pocket / Inventory Upgrades (Polydactyly -> Belly Button -> Deep Pockets -> Schoolbag)

steps.title: 3. Quality of Life & DeathLink
steps.description: Step 3: Configure RNG protections, alternate floor unlocks, and DeathLink severity

controls.label: Bad RNG Protection (Ensures critical progression isn't blocked by bad room RNG)
Alternate Floor Variations (Cellar, Catacombs, Necropolis, Utero, etc. require unlocks)
Enable DeathLink (Share death events with other players in the multiworld)

options.name: Mild (Receive 4 hits of damage; run continues if HP remains)
Normal (Fatal blow, but extra lives and revives trigger)
Severe (Immediate unavoidable death regardless of revives)
